Gog and Magog: two non-Arabic names, as shown by their restricted declension; only Asim reads both with hamzah. They descend from Japheth; alternatively, Gog are from the Turks and Magog from Jil and Daylam. They spread corruption on earth. It is said they ate people; also that they emerged in spring, ate every green thing and carried away every dry thing. None dies before seeing a thousand male descendants, all bearing arms. It is also said there are two kinds: extremely tall and extremely short.

It is said they ate people; also that they emerged in spring, ate every green thing and carried away every dry thing. None dies before seeing a thousand male descendants, all bearing arms. It is also said there are two kinds: extremely tall and extremely short.
